notes.title: Demo Out Now & Steam Next Fest Participation
notes.notes:
The [b]Hoops Ahead Demo[/b] is now available! Along with that, the game is participating in the [b]June 2025 Steam Next Fest[/b] (June 9th - June 16th). If you haven't already, make sure to wishlist Hoops Ahead and check out the trailer below!

[previewyoutube=yq04nF0L2sI;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Demo Note: The demo will limit each save file to one season but you can create as many save files as you want.[/i]
